dex.entry: The First Hour — the keeper of dusk, grown heavy with an evening it has never been allowed to put down. Lamp-tenders say every wick in Vesperholm is lit from the one coal it carries, at one remove or another.

art.silhouette: A long, low lynx-like beast, heavy-lidded and patient, built close to the ground like something settling in for the night. A banked mane of small, steady flame-tongues runs low along the neck and shoulders — embers, not fire. At its chest, a locket of teal sea-glass holds one bright coal. The tail ends in a slow curl of pale smoke. Reads at 64px as a dark animal carrying one precious light.
art.palette: Charcoal-violet fur deepening to ink (#1a1430) along the spine like a sky losing its light; ember amber (#ff8a3d) and rose for the banked mane; diamond-teal sea-glass locket; a faint dusk-rose gradient on the brow and flanks.
art.direction: The moment of lamp-lighting as an animal. Heavy, warm at the core, unhurried — the dusk as a keeper, not a threat. The single chest-coal must read as the brightest pixel on the sprite.
